title: OPERATIONS & REPORT
briefing: Two years. One CubeSat. Let's make the plan fit.
I'll keep the bus, power and mass inside their limits.
I'll plan the passes so at least 70% of our data gets home.
I'll choose the imager and plan coverage of Sarawak.
2.5 million, ready in 24 months. Work alone, launch together.

nova: A reserve is a plan for surprises.
Let's check what the other departments need.
orion: Weigh it twice. Then write it down.
The battery has to carry the night.
juno: Healthy leaf, dry leaf. That is our question.
A clear target is worth waiting for.
kai: A beautiful image still has to get home.
Clouds above, rain at the dish. We plan for both.

dialogue: Our satellite is alive. Now the real work begins.

beats.objective: Siti: review First Light in the lab
dialogue: Look. That is Sarawak, from space.
First Light: our target is a forest river in Sarawak. This is a simulated mission preview, not imagery captured by a real satellite.
A real report needs an image source line. Now, check our science plan.

beats.objective: Q2 - Siti: respond to heavy clouds
dialogue: Too many clouds. Switching to thermal.
We can adapt the observations and record what we could not see.
Q2 quarter log filed in Mission Control.
Check the backup link before this pass ends.
Q3 quarter log filed in Mission Control.
Rain is coming. Watching the needle!
Ka-band wobbles most. Keep the signal in the green.
Q4 quarter log filed in Mission Control.

beats.objective: Q5 - Jabu: manage the long eclipse
dialogue: A long night. What can wait until sunrise?
Keep the battery above zero. Science loads may have to pause.
Q5 quarter log filed in Mission Control.
An instrument glitch. Reading the sequence before I press anything.
I'll follow the pattern and log the interruption.
Q6 quarter log filed in Mission Control.

beats.objective: Q7 - Jabu: respond to the debris warning
dialogue: Thrusters give us a way to move. Without them, a near miss still carries risk.
Q7 quarter log filed in Mission Control.
The pack is running hot. Watching the red line.
Taking loads off and letting it cool. Then I check what we can safely restore.
Q8 quarter log filed in Mission Control.

beats.objective: Ling: close the last planned pass
dialogue: That was the last pass of the plan.
Count what reached home. Keep the missing data in the report too.
Mission Control is ready for the results.
We lost contact with the rocket. There is no satellite to operate.
Launch is hard. We still have the report. Let's see what we can learn.

beats.objective: Present the mission report in Mission Control
dialogue: Show the requirements, exact results and each lead's decisions.
Then explain why it happened. One clear lesson, one thing to try next.
Any showcase image needs its source. Our simulation does not claim a real capture.
Every mission leaves us something to learn.
